note: Zoom on the coat-peg and cubby corner of the lavender articles room (cartoon style): the possessives, whose is it? Left to right: mon (boy moaning over MY teddy), ton (strongman with YOUR ton of iron), son (father and his son with HIS toy boat), notre (OUR Notre-Dame model), votre (YOUR vote in the ballot box), leur (THEIR lures). Possessives have no gender of their own (divider null). The blank card on the wall is the sign.
